hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qiE "\.(env|secret|key|pem|vault)" && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -q ".env.example"; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot edit secrets/env files. Update .env manually or via vault scripts." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qiE "\.(tsx|ts|jsx|html)$"; then if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE "\bdonat(e|ion|ions|ing)\b" && ! echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE "not.*(charit|donat)|not a.*(donat|solicitat)"; then echo "BLOCKED: §496.405 — Do not use donate/donation language. Use disbursement or revenue split." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.(tsx?|jsx?|json|css|html|md)$"; then cd /c/ANTIGRAVITY && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0'
